# Nick Vvedenskyi — Revenue & Marketing for Tech and AI Products

> I help tech and AI founders figure out who buys, why they stay and where the money is hiding. Seven years, 44 projects across tech, AI, fintech, apps and B2B. Based in Spain, working with founders in Europe and the US in English and Ukrainian.

## Core belief

Be a friend to your customer. Not in a cheesy way. In the way where you actually know what they need, you tell them the truth, and they stay because leaving would feel weird.

## Services

### Buyer Sprint — Customer Discovery
I interview 10 to 12 of your customers, or people who should be your customers, and come back with who actually buys, why they buy and the exact words they use to describe the problem.
You get: ICP cards, buyer language map, top 3 segments, where the product falls short for each, clear next steps.
Timeline: 4 weeks.

### Brand-Market Fit — Positioning
Product-market fit means the product works. Brand-market fit means people understand why they should pick you over the other guys.
You get: positioning, messaging matrix, elevator pitch you can actually say out loud, brand guidelines lite.
Timeline: 3 weeks.

### Pipeline Audit — Sales
I go through your funnel and sales process, listen to call recordings, talk to people who did not buy and show you where the deals leak and why.
You get: funnel and sales audit, lost deal analysis, prioritized list of fixes.
Timeline: 2 weeks.

### Grow Through Your Customers — Retention
We find out why people leave, and then build what makes them stay: feedback loops, early warning signs, better communication with customers and referral mechanics.
You get: churn interviews, retention playbook, customer health signals, expansion map.
Timeline: 4 weeks.

### Revenue Unlock — Monetization
Pricing, packaging, upsells, annual plans and all the other places where the money is already in the business and nobody is picking it up.
You get: revenue structure review, pricing and packaging recommendations, quick wins, test plan.
Timeline: 2 weeks.

### Launch Sprint — Go-to-Market
Taking a new product or a new segment to market. Research and interviews to launch, with channel math that makes sense before you spend a single euro on ads.
You get: GTM strategy, ICP and messaging, channel plan with CAC math per channel, launch and experiments map.
Timeline: 2 months.

## How I work

1. We talk for 30 minutes. Free. You tell me what is going on, I ask questions, we figure out if I am the right person for this.
2. You get a proposal within 48 hours. Scope, price, timeline and exactly what you will have at the end.
3. We run the sprint. Weekly check-ins, you see the work while it happens.
4. You keep everything. Documents, systems and next steps your team can run without me.

The price is fixed and agreed before we start. I talk to your customers myself, not through a survey tool. Remote, Spanish time zone, in English or Ukrainian. Everything I make for you is yours to keep.

## Background

Seven years across politics (field coordination), cruise ships (15-person team management), factory marketing, three years as project manager at an agency with 30+ client projects, and now marketing lead at an AI startup. The thread: revenue, the whole chain of how a business finds people, earns their trust and keeps it.
